test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The dining hall was being thoroughly cleaned by the workers."

options.text: The workers were thoroughly cleaned the dinning hall.
The workers were thoroughly cleaning the dinning hall.
The workers had thoroughly cleaning the dinning hall.
The workers was thoroughly cleaning the dinning hall.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, the passive voice is: "The dining hall was being thoroughly cleaned by the workers."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the workers" at the beginning.
 
• Change the verb form "was being thoroughly cleaned" to "were thoroughly cleaning" (past continuous active).
 
• Ensure the object "the dining hall" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The workers were thoroughly cleaning the dining hall."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The workers were thoroughly cleaned the dining hall." – Incorrect verb form.
 
• **Option 3: **"The workers had thoroughly cleaning the dining hall." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"The workers was thoroughly cleaning the dining hall." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement.
